statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the block threshold while Stress stays elevated on a high long-end yield and firm crude backdrop.
recommendation: Tail at 24% maps to WATCH. The narrow danger window covers the 13:30Z US cash open through 15:00Z, where an aligned yield, crude and semiconductor backdrop could either confirm persistent directional structure or fail to do so. Observed evidence so far shows a retracement off the overnight low rather than one-way continuation.
headline: Nasdaq-100 steadies off its overnight low into the US cash open while long-end yields hold near multi-decade highs
body: NQ futures trade near 30,510, about -0.8% against the prior settle, after an overnight range of 30,370 to roughly 30,813. The index has recovered about 140 points from that low, so session-extreme holding is not currently observed. The 10-year yield is 5.10%, below its 5.13 session high, and the 30-year is 5.41% within a 5.40-5.43 range, so the long-end selloff that defined the prior session is steady rather than extending today. VIX near 16.0 is up about 5% but remains low in absolute terms and sits below its 16.57 high. WTI crude near $93.64 is up about 1.6% and off its $94.68 high, keeping an inflation amplifier present without extension. Initial jobless claims printed at 197,000 against a 201,000 consensus, reinforcing the labour-market strength that supports higher yields. Shared delayed context shows the prior session closing with all eight tracked megacaps and all seven tracked semiconductors lower, and semiconductor equipment down about 2.1%, an aligned negative tone that is latest-session rather than live. Against that, the announced two-month extension of the US-China trade truce and the ongoing state visit are de-escalatory. The combination of an aligned bearish cross-asset stack with a low absolute VIX, stabilising yields and an observed retracement keeps Tail in the watch band rather than at a blocking level. The US cash open inside the current hour is the principal unobserved checkpoint.

lookbackSummary: The preceding 24 hours held a persistent watch-band regime. Tail peaked at 25% around 09:00Z during the European long-end selloff and again at 25% in the 14:00Z slot of the prior session, easing to the 17-20% low band through the quiet overnight window before rebuilding to 24% by 12:00Z as European rates trade re-priced. Stress stayed elevated throughout, between 49% and 58%, reflecting a high-yield, firm-crude backdrop rather than an observed mean-reversion failure.
outlookSummary: The narrow conditional peak is the 14:00Z window, where the opening auction and New Home Sales coincide and Tail steps to 25%. From mid-morning New York onward the forecast assumes post-open volatility decay, easing into the low band through the evening and Asian sessions, with a modest closing-hour lift at 19:00Z. Conditional Tail returns to the watch band from the European open at 06:00Z on 25 September and lifts to 23% for the 12:00Z window containing Durable Goods Orders. Every slot beyond the current hour describes conditional risk, and observed shallow pullbacks, repeated extension after failed retracements, or the index holding near its extremes would be required before any of it is treated as confirmed.
